subject.title: fix(qqbot): surface terminal reply-session conflict failures

question: Should this P1 QQBot mitigation land with its strict local classifier now, or wait until the shared Plugin SDK classifier in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109902 is approved and consumable?
rationale: Landing now restores user-visible failure handling sooner, while sequencing the shared classifier first better follows the repository’s plugin-boundary policy and avoids another error-text source of truth.

options.title: Sequence the shared classifier
options.body: Approve and land a suitably scoped shared classifier first, then rebase this PR to consume it while retaining the proven QQBot terminal-notice behavior.

options.title: Land the mitigation now
options.body: Accept the local strict classifier as a short-lived P1 mitigation and require an explicit QQBot migration when the shared classifier lands.

options.title: Pause both changes
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers do not want either a local classifier or the proposed Plugin SDK contract yet, leaving current silent terminal failures unresolved.

recommendation.title: Sequence the shared classifier
recommendation.body: Approve and land a suitably scoped shared classifier first, then rebase this PR to consume it while retaining the proven QQBot terminal-notice behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice directly affects QQBot’s gateway and outbound ownership boundary, where this person has recent substantial feature history.
